International Standards and Regional Requirements

ISO standards establish internationally recognized approaches to NDT methodology and quality assurance. ISO 5579 covers ultrasonic testing of metals, ISO 11699 addresses industrial radiography, ISO 1316 covers eddy current testing. Adoption of ISO standards enables facilities to demonstrate capability recognized across global markets and comply with international contracts requiring specific standards compliance.

EN (European Norms) standards establish requirements for facilities operating in European Union jurisdictions. EN 12668 addresses ultrasonic testing, EN 10228 covers acceptance criteria for steel forgings. These standards often exceed ASME or API requirements in specific areas, necessitating compliance with most stringent applicable standards. NDT consulting services navigate complex multi-jurisdictional compliance frameworks.

Regional standards in Middle East, Asia-Pacific, and other markets reflect local operating conditions and regulatory philosophies. Industry-specific standards for aerospace, automotive, and other sectors establish unique requirements reflecting sector-specific risks and operational environments. NDT training programs prepare personnel for sector-specific requirements and international standards compliance.

Harmonization of international standards continues advancing toward consistent global approaches, reducing compliance complexity for multinational operators while maintaining regional risk management priorities.
